visibleTestCases.title: Settling Valid Transaction
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, W} = payment_system:start_system(3), Res = payment_system:charge(W, <<"req_1">>, 250, usd), payment_system:stop_system(W), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Charges 250 USD and returns settled receipt map.

visibleTestCases.title: Idempotency Protection Against Double-Charge
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, W} = payment_system:start_system(3), {ok, _} = payment_system:charge(W, <<"req_dup">>, 100, usd), Res = payment_system:charge(W, <<"req_dup">>, 100, usd), payment_system:stop_system(W), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Second charge with identical RequestId returns already_processed without re-charging.

visibleTestCases.title: Worker Crash Recovery and Transaction Store Survival
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, W} = payment_system:start_system(3), {ok, _} = payment_system:charge(W, <<"req_saved">>, 50, eur), {ok, OldW, NewW} = payment_system:trigger_crash_test(W), Txs = payment_system:get_processed_txs(W), payment_system:stop_system(W), {OldW =/= NewW, maps:is_key(<<"req_saved">>, Txs)} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Worker crashed and was replaced with a new PID, while tx_store survived 100% intact.
